goal: Complete the Map Dex ecosystem feature for Grassland with a substantial explanation and an illustrated ecosystem pyramid.
acceptance_criteria: Grassland has a substantial ecosystem explanation beyond its general map description.
The unlocked Grassland detail shows a four-layer ecosystem pyramid and explains that it is not a battle-strength ranking.
Every species in the Grassland encounter list appears exactly once in the pyramid, circulation notes, or visitor notes.
Monster entries in the diagram link to the existing encyclopedia detail.
Undiscovered maps continue to hide ecosystem information.
The layout remains usable at mobile width without changing save data or game rules.

phases.name: goal_and_boundary
phases.deliverable: Fix Grassland-only scope, acceptance criteria, risk, tests, and stop condition.

phases.name: system_and_content_implementation
phases.deliverable: Add the Grassland explanation, four trophic layers, circulation and visitor notes, linked species cards, responsive styling, notice, and dedicated checks.

phases.name: integration_qa_and_safe_merge
phases.deliverable: Dedicated and full checks passed; PR #136 CI succeeded from current main without conflict and was squash-merged.

phases.name: pages_and_published_verification
phases.deliverable: Main CI and Pages succeeded; published HTML, data, renderer, notice, and responsive CSS contain the new Grassland feature.

phases.name: completion_and_stop
phases.deliverable: Final evidence is recorded, v1 waiting state is restored, and no further backlog item is selected.

published_verification: The published title is Monster Battle Ver8.0.
The published HTML references cache-busted Grassland pyramid data, renderer, and responsive CSS.
The published data contains the four trophic layers and the battle-strength disclaimer.
The published renderer links diagram species to existing encyclopedia details.
The published notice and mobile responsive rules are present.
stop_condition: After Phase 48 is recorded and published, do not select or start another backlog item.
